entry.availability_time: Original public claim issued_time_utc,not source_time_utc or browser receipt time.
entry.execution_claim: Reproducible public-price proxy,not guaranteed bid/ask,order fill,commission or slippage.
entry.price: price of the first eligible aggTrade;retain its trade ID and transact timestamp
entry.prior_prices: Never use the source token close as the V3 entry.
entry.timestamp_precision: Compare integer exchange milliseconds against the full original UTC issue timestamp;equal times are not strictly after.

historical_rejudge: V3 can retrospectively re-evaluate previously committed live signals;this is not represented as their originally published V2 score.
historical_research: Where actual issue times were never recorded,any delay scenario is a labeled simulation,not measured live issuance.

market_source.integrity: Contiguous increasing trade IDs and nondecreasing transact time;unknown gaps/conflicts or insufficient prefix hold verification.

outcome.expiry_boundary: Trades at or before the expiry timestamp are eligible;later complete source coverage certifies expiration.
outcome.external_timestamp_rule: Trusted external signal timestamp strictly before the crossing trade transact timestamp.
outcome.first_eligible_event: A subsequent trade after the entry trade.
outcome.first_touch: First chronological subsequent trade whose price reaches either barrier. Trade IDs break equal-millisecond ties.
outcome.resolution_time: Actual crossing trade transact timestamp,not a20sbar close.

purpose: Evaluate unchanged predictions from actual recorded availability,using a public-trade entry proxy.

scoring.NO_SIGNAL: Not a signal denominator member except existing missing-opening penalties.
scoring.population: All unchanged accepted disclosed claims. No outcome-based reselection.
scoring.unrevealed_or_missing_pack: All existing V4/V4.1 penalties remain in force.
